svg.title: Check the process, listener and HTTP page.
svg.desc: Full ps, ss and curl commands inspect the running local demo from a second terminal. Short illustrative selected outputs show a Python process, loopback port 8000 listener, and HTTP 200 with Hello body. Process IDs and headers may differ. A missing.html request is explicitly a summary of a different request, not output from GET /. Connection refusal is not an HTTP response.
svg.text: CHECK THE PROCESS, PORT AND PAGE.
Local demo running; second terminal. Commands + illustrative selected output below.
Different request, log summary: GET /missing.html → 404 if that file is absent.
Refused connection isn't HTTP. Wrong page? Inspect the served file and directory.
